evals.prompt: Define epistemic grounding in 2-3 sentences. Include source, modality, and warrant.
expected_elements: Every assertion is bound to a verifiable source
Claim strength or modality is marked
The warrant from source to claim is visible
Grounding turns generated text into defended text
Grounding is distinct from confident tone

evals.prompt: Explain the Toulmin-style mental model behind epistemic grounding. Name at least five primitives and how they relate.
expected_elements: Names claim
Names data or source
Names warrant
Names backing, qualifier, or rebuttal
Explains that data plus warrant supports the claim
Explains qualifier/modality sets strength

evals.prompt: Distinguish epistemic-grounding from methodology, semantics, evaluation, and first-principles-thinking. Give a mechanism-level reason for each boundary.
expected_elements: methodology owns execution completeness and evidence receipts
semantics owns naming and meaning precision
evaluation owns scoring frameworks and result interpretation
first-principles-thinking owns reasoning from primitives
epistemic-grounding owns source-to-claim warrants and grounding state

evals.prompt: A draft says, 'The API probably returns JSON.' Explain why the hedge does not make the claim grounded and rewrite it in a grounded form if the source is a local test run.
expected_elements: Says hedging and grounding are different axes
Identifies 'probably' as reduced claim strength, not evidence
Requires a source such as a test, curl output, or file citation
Marks verified or inferred status
Includes a source-to-claim connection in the rewrite

evals.prompt: Rewrite this audit finding so every claim is either sourced or marked as inference: 'The router is broken because boundary is implemented backwards and this probably causes bad skill selection.'
expected_elements: Separates observed facts from inferred impact
Requires source citations such as code paths, docs, or command output
Avoids unsourced 'broken' wording
Marks probable impact as inferred unless directly tested
Makes the warrant from evidence to claim visible
